For `#tag`, I’d prefer an exact match. The looser matching is helpful while choosing a tag, but once I search for `#recipes`, I expect only bookmarks with that specific tag. I can type ordinary text when I want a broader match.

The malformed-search fallback sounds good as long as the message remains visible and clearly explains that the operators weren’t understood. Showing useful word matches is friendlier than making the list appear empty. With that exact-tag adjustment, the search behaviour matches what I want.
